result.brief: 提出物理先验的可微世界模型，显式预测接触力旋量与残余广义力，经拉格朗日前向动力学计算下一状态，用于人形机器人全身运动跟踪。
result.reason: Physics-informed differentiable world model predicting contact wrenches and residual forces for humanoid motion tracking; world modeling with Lagrangian dynamics, though main contribution is robot policy learning.
